subject: Security review kickoff & scope - Acme Health
messages:
From: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security review kickoff - Acme Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Per our discussion, we'd like to kick off the security review for Redwood before we move forward with procurement. Attached is Acme's standard security intake (Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) to help capture initial scope and compliance items.

A few clarifying items we need to confirm:
- Systems in scope: will Redwood's hosted API endpoints (production and staging) + any embedded model infra used for our data be included?
- Data residency: we need confirmation on regional processing (US-only or multi-region).
- Auth: SSO / SCIM support and available audit logs for user activity.
- Timeline: procurement would like a 2-3 week turnaround for the questionnaire and SOC2 evidence if possible.

Stakeholders on our side: Asha Gupta (security lead), Tom Reynolds (procurement) - cc'd, and our Legal intake alias. Could you confirm Redwood owners and propose next steps?

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Gupta
Head of Security Programs
Acme Health

Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@acme-health.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Acme Health

Hi Asha —

Great to meet you on the call. Thanks for sending the intake. We're happy to kick this off. I attached our standard security questionnaire (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) which aligns to most vendor intake forms to speed things up.

Proposed high-level scope / owners from Redwood:
- Security review lead / primary contact: Marissa Cole (me) — I'll coordinate evidence collection and timelines.
- Technical lead (systems & network): Dev Patel — he'll handle infra/network questions and any environment-specific asks.
- Sales engineer / product mapping: Rishi Malhotra — will support API, feature, and deployment questions.

Short answers to your bullets:
- Systems in scope: by default we'll include Redwood hosted API (prod + staging). If you want private deployment (VPC) in scope, flag that and we'll add it to the questionnaire.
- Data residency: Redwood can confirm region of processing per account — our hosted offering processes in the region you select; we will include region-specific details in the questionnaire.
- Auth / audit logs: we support API keys and SSO via SAML/OIDC for enterprise plans; we do retain audit logs and can provide retention windows and log format in the evidence bundle.
- Timeline: we can target a 2-week turnaround for the completed questionnaire and initial SOC2 evidence if you can prioritize review and provide any additional stakeholders.

Next steps I propose:
1) We (Redwood) complete our questionnaire and return to you by Oct 1.
2) Schedule a technical kickoff w/ your infra/security and our Dev + Rishi — suggested slot Oct 4 or Oct 5.
3) We'll deliver SOC2 report excerpts and network diagram as requested.

I've attached our questionnaire; Dev, assigning you to review "systems in scope" and confirm the network diagram we'll share.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Acme Health

Asha / Marissa —

Following up on systems-in-scope details. For clarity, please confirm whether you want the following included:
- Hosted public API endpoints (production + staging) — default included
- Embeddings / vector store (if Acme will index PHI or regulated data) — please confirm whether any regulated data will be sent
- Any private deployment (VPC) instances — if yes, we'll need network CIDR ranges and the VPC design to validate inbound/outbound flows

I've attached a simple network diagram that shows our standard hosted topology; once you confirm the scope I'll update it with any account-specific bits. Also, what level of log access is required (aggregated audit events vs full request logs)? That impacts redaction/privacy controls.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Network_Diagram.png

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@acme-health.com>, Legal Intake <legal@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:39:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Acme Health

Marissa / team —

Thanks — quick procurement notes from our side to help scope the timeline:
- Intake + questionnaire completion is required before procurement will engage on standard terms.
- After questionnaire we typically request SOC2 report excerpts and a standard vendor addendum; Legal may request redlines but that usually happens after security sign-off.
- Economic buyer: our CFO will review once security/technical sign-off is complete.
- Decision criteria: data handling (retention & encryption), SLA (uptime & support), and regional processing.

Tentative timeline: if Redwood returns the completed questionnaire and SOC2 excerpts by Oct 1-2, procurement can move to contract review the week of Oct 11.

One ask: please include an export/data deletion workflow and contact for support/incident escalation in the questionnaire answers.

Best,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@acme-health.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-health.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Acme Health (summary & next steps)

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks for the clarity and the procurement notes — helpful. Quick summary and next steps so everyone's aligned:

Owners
- Security review lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- Technical lead: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com) — will own network/infra questions and the network diagram
- SE / product: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) — API/feature mapping and decision-criteria support

Scope
- Include: Hosted API (prod + staging), audit logs, SSO/OAuth flows.
- Please confirm if embeddings/vector-store of regulated data is in scope — that will change evidence we provide.

Deliverables & timeline
1) Redwood to fill out and return questionnaire (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) by Oct 1 — done (attached).
2) Redwood to provide SOC2 excerpts and network diagram by Oct 4.
3) Technical kickoff: propose Oct 4 @ 10:00 AM PT. If that works for your team we'll send a calendar invite.
4) Procurement: target contract review week of Oct 11 pending security deliverables.

Action items for Acme
- Asha: confirm whether embeddings/vector-store or any regulated PHI will be sent to Redwood.
- Tom / procurement: confirm procurement contact and PO process details (DocuSign / PO / standard terms).

I'll attach the completed questionnaire and the network diagram to the invite. If anything else is needed, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
